decisions.statement: An addon with no build is refused rather than placed.
Each sibling folder the manifest declares is replaced beside the addon.
A placed entry is verified against its source by sha256.
A symbolic link in a build is verified rather than passed over.
A folder with no build stamp was placed by something else.
Such a folder new enough for every version this fleet asks of it is left alone.
Such a folder is refused rather than deleted on missing evidence.
The extra Lua files a manifest names are carried across the replacement.
A manifest that went unread is refused rather than read as naming no file.
A placement says how many of the files the manifest names it carried across.
The saved-variables migrations run after the files are in place.
A replacement that breaks off part way is refused rather than thrown on.

definition: an addon's folder in the game replaced with what the build output has
